title: Unrelated staged index changes can evade all live source scope checks when working bytes are restored
description: The new live guard compares the working tree with the accepted commit using git diff --name-only -z <baseline> --. It never inspects the cached index delta. A real unrelated staged change to MAPPING_SEMANTICS.md with working bytes restored to the original passes prepare, apply, and verify_completed and emits a complete non-recovery receipt. This works when staged before prepare and after prepare. HEAD and working contract bytes remain exact, but the index contains a different contract outside the allowed owner paths.
reproduction: Create the genuine private demotion fixture with the frozen21061 test helper; preserve real baseline and accepted review tuple.
Modify tracked MAPPING_SEMANTICS.md, run git add -- MAPPING_SEMANTICS.md, then write its original bytes back without modifying the index.
Confirm git diff --name-only -z <baseline> -- is empty, while git diff --cached --name-only -z <baseline> -- lists MAPPING_SEMANTICS.md and status is MM.
Call actual prepare/apply/verify_completed with untouched native functions. Both initial and late variants report complete and retire the source owner.
Compare clean positive and ordinary staged working-byte drift negative: positive completes; ordinary drift refuses before any source write or receipt.
minimal_fix_scope: Retain exact baseline HEAD and literal NUL path handling, and independently include cached/index changes in the live tracked-scope check. Explicitly define allowed operation-path staged semantics rather than assuming working bytes prove the index. Run the combined checks at the same prewrite, transition, and final live boundaries. Do not extend current-HEAD checks to historical completed verification or weaken payload/content/proof checks.
required_tests: Initial and post-prepare staged index-only unrelated drift must refuse before own writes and receipt creation.
Midflight index-only drift at actual transition/final live boundaries must fail with honest recovery evidence.
Unicode/newline literal paths, explicit reviewed demotion, positive clean apply, and later historical exact-content commits remain supported.
Both staged and unstaged unrelated tracked changes remain refused; negative controls keep original all23 #1255 inputs and all prior assertion coverage.
lineage: Partial correction of prior W08-16C-CODE-002 (#1256): actual late HEAD and ordinary working-file drift controls now refuse, but the requested staged unrelated scope is not fully enforced. Original findings, failed attempts and severities are retained. This is a file-ready residual for coordinator deduplication, not a new issue filed by reviewer.

independent_confirmation.scope: Read actual saved index/worktree Git objects and receipt bytes; ran actual verify_completed on the three complete fixtures without reapplying.
